title: Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream
description: Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream expands Nintendo’s Mii-driven life-simulation formula on Nintendo Switch. Players create or collect Mii characters, customize profiles, build an island community, place shops and facilities, follow daily Mii News, manage relationships, and influence the island without directly controlling every event. Nintendo lists the title as Nintendo Switch software with Nintendo Switch 2 backward compatibility, not as a native Switch 2 Edition.

gameplayPillars.title: Create expressive Mii residents
gameplayPillars.description: Build Mii characters from scratch or through guided creation and give them personalities, voices, relationships, and roles.

gameplayPillars.title: Shape the island
gameplayPillars.description: Place homes, stores, restaurants, and facilities to change what residents can do and how the community develops.

gameplayPillars.title: Watch emergent relationships
gameplayPillars.description: Friendships, conflicts, crushes, living arrangements, and surprising social events emerge as time passes.

gameplayPillars.title: Mii News and daily happenings
gameplayPillars.description: The game surfaces island events through humorous news broadcasts and recurring daily activities.

gameplayPillars.title: Exchange creations locally
gameplayPillars.description: Nintendo describes local wireless features for sharing Mii characters and Palette House workshop creations with nearby friends.

storyChapters.title: Build your first island residents
storyChapters.body: The player begins by creating the people who will populate the new island community.

storyChapters.title: Expand the community
storyChapters.body: New buildings and services give Mii characters more places to meet, shop, relax, and create stories.

storyChapters.title: Follow friendships and drama
storyChapters.body: Relationships change over time, creating everyday comedy, grudges, romance, and unexpected pairings.

storyChapters.title: Customize homes and public spaces
storyChapters.body: The island increasingly reflects the player’s creative decisions and resident personalities.

storyChapters.title: Let the dream keep evolving
storyChapters.body: There is no single traditional ending; the long-term appeal is watching the social simulation continue to produce new situations.

features: Daily events and relationship-driven emergent stories

faq.q: Is Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream a Switch 2 game?
faq.a: No native Switch 2 Edition is listed. Nintendo sells it as Nintendo Switch software and lists Switch 2 backward compatibility.

faq.q: What do you do in the game?
faq.a: You create Mii residents, care for them, build their island, follow relationships, and react to humorous daily events.

faq.q: Is there a traditional story campaign?
faq.a: No. The game is an ongoing life simulation built around emergent resident behavior.
Nintendo describes local wireless exchange for Mii characters and Palette House workshop creations.

faq.q: Does it support Save Data Cloud?
faq.a: Yes. Nintendo lists Save Data Cloud support.

verdictCons: Limited appeal for players who dislike passive simulations
Some activities depend on real-time daily cycles
